name: Fùxì
description: A comprehensive benchmark evaluating large language models on ancient Chinese text understanding and generation, covering 21 diverse tasks including poetry composition and couplet completion, with specialized metrics for linguistic accuracy and cultural authenticity.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark from the Chinese-language LLM evaluation literature, mainly used in academic studies of ancient Chinese understanding and generation rather than broad leaderboard adoption.
notes: Includes both comprehension and generation tasks with a focus on cultural authenticity and classical Chinese formats.
